observations.behavior: Adds documentation and a gauge for channel depth, and a batch receive to avoid channel starvation.
observations.code_quote: The loop takes updates in batches of up to `UPDATE_DRAIN_BATCH` (256) per receive. Tokio's cooperative budget allows a task 128 budgeted operations per poll, and each receive is one, so one update per receive lets a CPU-starved pod drain slower than events arrive.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog avoid dropping rate limit updates when the background task is CPU-starved, preserving the global rate limiter's accuracy.
